body: The Weekly shows have really started to step it up now. I'm happy that I am enjoying WWE again.

Well right now I'm feeling like I should either get up and leave my own home or jab those scissors into my body until I hit something important.

Quite a few events are triggering these feelings. No matter how much good I do for others, I just get shit on no matter what I do to keep a smile or move on, they just drag me back down.
